info.name: Bet9ja API
info.description:
Bet9ja task management system — NestJS backend REST API (base: {{baseUrl}})

Authentication: All endpoints require a Bearer token from Keycloak except those marked @Public.
Set {{accessToken}} after login via Keycloak. The refresh/logout endpoints accept {{refreshToken}}.

v1.1: added Departments > Request Types, the Utilities folder, the Utility Requests folder, and Settings > SMTP (replacing the old Resend-based email config).

request.description: @Public — Authenticate with email and password via Keycloak ROPC grant. Returns accessToken + refreshToken. The post-response script auto-saves both tokens to environment variables.
@Public — Exchange a Keycloak refresh token for a new access token. Post-response script auto-saves new tokens.
@Public — Revoke the refresh token. Returns 204 No Content.
Returns the authenticated user's profile. Also auto-creates the user row in the DB on first call after login. Updates lastLogin and isOnline.

@Public — Sends a 6-digit OTP to the user's email. OTP is stored in Redis with a 10-minute TTL. Always returns success to prevent email enumeration. Check your email for the code, then call Reset Password.

@Public — Validates the OTP from Redis and sets a new permanent password via Keycloak admin API. OTP is deleted immediately after successful validation. Returns 400 if OTP is expired, never issued, or incorrect.

Requires Bearer token — For users on their first login (isFirstLogin = true). Sets a permanent password in Keycloak, removes the UPDATE_PASSWORD required action, and marks isFirstLogin = false in the DB. Call this after the user logs in with their temporary password.
Marks isFirstLogin = false without changing the password. Use Set Permanent Password instead if you also need to change the password.

request.description: Roles: root_admin. All fields optional. smtp replaces the old env-var-based Resend config — outgoing email (welcome mail, password-reset OTPs, ticket/utility-request notifications) is sent through whatever SMTP connection is saved here, via Nodemailer. provider is one of office365 | gmail | custom; encryption is one of tls | ssl | none. password is encrypted at rest, same as paystackSecretKey.

Roles: root_admin. Sends a one-off test email through the saved SMTP configuration. Pass an `smtp` object in the body (same shape as Update Settings' smtp field) to test an in-progress edit instead of what's already saved. Returns 400 with the underlying SMTP error if the connection or credentials are bad.
Roles: root_admin. Uploads org logo to Cloudinary. Returns Cloudinary URL.

Uploads to Cloudinary. Returns attachment record with Cloudinary URL. Standalone uploads for a utility-request comment aren't typically needed — the Utility Requests > Add Comment request uploads inline via multipart.
Owner or root_admin. Deletes from Cloudinary and DB. Returns 204.

The only chat endpoint the backend exposes — token signing requires the Stream app secret, which never leaves the server. The frontend uses this token to connect the stream-chat JS client directly to Stream for everything else: provisioning the user (connectUser already syncs name/image for the connecting user), querying/creating channels, sending messages, presence, and read receipts. No other chat operation is proxied through this API.
